_comment: Independent one-year 15-minute optimizer for MA + R:R Strategy v5. PARAMETER REDUCTION + REALISM PASS 2026-08-21: the search space was cut from 31 parameters to 7. A permutation control over the 7,242,202 archived evals (archive/reduce_20260821/) showed 24 of the 31 were statistically indistinguishable from chance -- their apparent 'pin cost' was pure selection bias from taking a maximum over hundreds of thousands of draws, not a real effect. The 31-dim space held 1.5e19 combinations, so 7.2M evals covered ~0% of it and the GA could never resolve the dimensions. The 7 survivors span 185,220 combinations, which is exhaustively searchable. Cost model brought in line with the Lean trees: fixed $1000 cash per trade (qty_pct_equity 100 -> 0), initialCapital 1000 -> 10000 so $1000/trade is a genuine 10% slice, commission 0.1% PER SIDE (0.2% round trip, Binance spot taker), slippage 0 -> 2 ticks. IS/OOS: range.split is the in-sample/out-of-sample boundary. The GA only ever scores the IS window; OOS metrics come from the same run and ride on every record, so a curve-fitted config shows up as an IS->OOS collapse.
